_doc: REQ-0066 season registry -- seasons are CONTENT, not code (server/services/ragnarok.cjs derives the current season/phase/countdown lazily from this file; no scheduler). One entry per season: index (1-based), name (ja, the display name -- the mock renders 「狼の冬」), nameEn, startAt (ISO), phaseDays [TUNABLE], phasesPerSeason (12 -- the mock's season wheel has exactly 12 wedges), ragnarokAt (= startAt + phasesPerSeason*phaseDays days by convention; stored explicitly so content can shorten/extend a season deliberately -- the stored value wins). Season 1 seeded [ORCH]: named 狼の冬 per the design mock, phaseDays 7 => an 84-day season.
